kind: Historical exact inventory function/loop excerpts from the two successful read-only commands; not a cleanup utility
actual_code_boundary: Original import/setup, outer descriptive record initialization, final JSON writing/printing and subsequent author readback are omitted. All path-open/walk/metadata-digest/count/suffix/root-output bodies relevant to inventory reproduction are reproduced below. No cleanup body is included.

bindings.record: First command record with empty roots list before the excerpt
bindings.r: JSON loaded from the held receipt; first roots array is unchanged since inventory1

digest_recipe.traversal: Per root, depth-first recursive walk; sorted(os.listdir(dfd)) at every directory; process directory metadata before descending into that directory.
digest_recipe.relative_path: q=rel+'/'+name if rel else name; no leading slash; no path normalization or additional sorting after traversal.
digest_recipe.serialization: (json.dumps(tuple_as_list, separators=(',',':')) + '\n').encode(); default ensure_ascii=True and default UTF-8 encoding; one LF after every record.
digest_recipe.digest: Fresh hashlib.sha256 per root and per kind; hexdigest() after traversal. File payload contents are not hashed by this inventory.
digest_recipe.counter: collections.Counter; dict(counter) preserves missing zero-count keys as absent, notably files/apparent_bytes/allocated_bytes in the six directory-only roots.
digest_recipe.allocated_bytes: Sum st_blocks*512 over regular files only.
digest_recipe.timestamps: Directory times recorded observationally; excluded only from directory stability digest. File mtime/ctime remain in the file stability digest.

approved_ancestor_boundary: Fresh O_NOFOLLOW validation of every absolute prefix component. Cross-command identity equality compares anc[2:] beginning at [b4a17a285e23,27,2889817]; anc[:2] recorded observationally. Root-approved refinement is recorded in held receipt.
failed_inventory_preserved: Earlier second attempt exited1 on full ancestor comparison. Neither excerpt nor new success retroactively credits it.
root_action_boundary: Root owns any fresh immediate inventory, opened-leaf fstat checks, unusable marking, payload mutation and separate persistence. These historical excerpts perform none of those mutations.

author_readback.digest_constants: Each file/directory update appends one actual LF byte after JSON serialization.
